m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You managed to see all five classical pieces of Zafarian rock art? Amazing! I hope it gives you a better understanding.
Hello, young Wizard. Are you interested in learning the history of Zafaria? It is a bittersweet story of shadows and light.
The best way to understand Zafaria is to experience it. There are five masterpieces of ancient rock art that survive to date.
The first is in our Library. You'll have to locate the others on your own.
It's been too long since I've seen them, and I've forgotten the way. Once you've seen them all, tell me what you think.
Explore the history of Zafaria by viewing the five masterpieces of ancient rock art. Then return and tell me what you think.
